description: This file defines an abstract class Connection within the Orleans.Runtime.Messaging namespace. It manages network connections, including establishing connections, processing incoming and outgoing messages, handling connection closure, and error handling. It leverages pipelines, channels, and dependency injection for message serialization and transport management. The class also logs various connection states and message processing events.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: An abstract class managing network connection lifecycle, message processing, and error handling within Orleans runtime. It handles both incoming and outgoing messages, connection setup, teardown, and rerouting of failed messages. It uses pipelines and channels for efficient message transmission and supports dependency injection for serialization and message handling.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts processing this connection, including invoking middleware and handling errors.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Initiates the closing process for the connection, ensuring all resources are released properly.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues a message for sending over the connection.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initiate message processing tasks after connection setup.

methods.name: OnConnectedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when a new connection is established, starting processing.

methods.name: ProcessIncoming
methods.description: Loop to process incoming messages from the transport input.

methods.name: ProcessOutgoing
methods.description: Loop to process and send outgoing messages.
